"Check for recordings" flow lost: view_recordings disabled for unrecorded Cal Video bookings
The old code showed a "check_for_recordings" button for past, confirmed Cal Video bookings with isRecorded false, and it opened ViewRecordingsDialog. The refactor drops that. getVideoOptionsActions in bookingActions.ts always uses the label t("view_recordings") and disables the action unless booking.isRecorded is true. The component then adds `(action.id === "view_recordings" && !booking.isRecorded)` to `disabled` (lines 392-395). A past, confirmed Cal Video booking with isRecorded=false therefore gets

isActionDisabled disagrees with getVideoOptionsActions for view_recordings
getVideoOptionsActions disables view_recordings unless isBookingInPast && isConfirmed && isCalVideoLocation && booking.isRecorded. isActionDisabled("view_recordings") (line 213-214) ignores booking.isRecorded and uses booking.status === ACCEPTED instead of isConfirmed. For a past, accepted Cal Video booking with isRecorded=false, isActionDisabled returns false (enabled) while the action list marks it disabled. The same mismatch applies to meeting_session_details on the status check. Production code only calls isActionDi

AvailabilitySettingsFormRef imported from a module that does not export it
AvailabilitySettingsPlatformWrapper.tsx line 15 imports `AvailabilitySettingsFormRef` from "../AvailabilitySettings". That file only imports the type from "./types" (line 49). It does not export or re-export it. The type is defined and exported in availability/types.ts:38. The import therefore fails type-checking (TS2305), and the wrapper's `forwardRef<AvailabilitySettingsFormRef, ...>` generic cannot resolve.
The platform atoms package fails type-check or build, so the new forwardRef wrapper cannot be compiled or used.

Effect cleanup now resets the event-type query on every data change, not just on unmount or id change
The change added `eventTypeQueryData` to the dependency array of the `useEffect` whose cleanup calls `invalidateQueries` and `resetQueries`. The comment says this should run only on unmount or when the id changes. Now the cleanup also runs whenever the query data reference changes while the previous data was truthy. One example is the refetch after a save. The cleanup then calls `resetQueries`, which sets the data to undefined. The wrapper then returns null (`if (!eventTypeQueryData) return nu

Booking update trigger leaves booking user name, email and avatar stale when userId changes
trigger_refresh_routing_form_response_denormalized_booking sets "bookingUserId" = NEW."userId" when a Booking's userId, status or times change. It does not update "bookingUserName", "bookingUserEmail" or "bookingUserAvatarUrl". The initial refresh function fills those three columns from the users join. The users trigger only fires on users updates, and it filters on "bookingUserId".
